text: He killed one hundred people... and still asked: can I be forgiven?
A man killed ninety-nine people, then asked a monk: can I be forgiven? The monk said no... so he killed him too.
Then a scholar said: who can stand between you and repentance? Go to a land that worships Allah.
He set out on the road... but death came to him on the way.
The land was measured. He was closer to the good land, by a hand's span. And Allah forgave him.
